description_en: Queries the remediation execution records of a rule in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内规则的修正执行记录
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregate-remediation-executions --config-rule-id cr-2792626622af0c210000 --aggregator-id ca-edd3626622af00b30000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregateRemediationExecutions

parameters.help_en: The rule ID. You can call ListAggregateConfigRules to obtain the rule ID. Before calling this operation, you must call CreateAggregateRemediation to create remediation settings for the rule. Otherwise, the server returns Invalid.ConfigRuleId.Value
parameters.help_zh: 规则 ID，可通过 ListAggregateConfigRules 获取。调用前必须先通过 CreateAggregateRemediation 为该规则创建修正设置，否则服务端返回 Invalid.ConfigRuleId.Value
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Valid values: 10 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：10~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The remediation execution status. Valid values:

Success: The remediation was successful.

Failed: The remediation failed
parameters.help_zh:
修正执行状态，取值：

Success：成功。

Failed：失败
parameters.name: execution_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of a member account in the account group. If this parameter is not specified, the remediation results of the account that created the rule are queried. If the account is not a member of the account group, an empty result is returned
parameters.help_zh: 账号组内成员账号ID。不填写时查询该规则创建账号的修正结果，若此账号不在账号组内时，返回结果为空
parameters.name: resource_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned in a single request
MaxResults.description_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

RemediationExecutions.description_en: The list of remediation execution records

items.description_en: The list of remediation execution records

ExecutionCreateDate.description_en: The time when the remediation execution record was created. The time is in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format, with Z at the end, such as 2023-06-25T11:48:15Z
ExecutionCreateDate.description_zh: 修正执行记录创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，末尾以 Z 标识，例如 2023-06-25T11:48:15Z

ExecutionInvocationId.description_en: The invocation ID of the remediation execution record

ExecutionResourceIds.description_en: The IDs of the remediated resources. Multiple resource IDs are separated by commas (,)
ExecutionResourceIds.description_zh: 修正的资源ID。多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExecutionResourceType.description_en: The type of the remediated resource

ExecutionStatus.description_en:
The status of the remediation execution record. Valid values:

Success: The remediation was successful.

Failed: The remediation failed
ExecutionStatus.description_zh:
修正执行记录状态，取值：

Success：成功。

Failed：失败

ExecutionStatusMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the remediation execution failed
ExecutionStatusMessage.description_zh: 修正执行失败的错误信息
